global.title: U.S. removes Syria from state sponsor of terrorism list
global.summary: The U.S. has removed Syria from its terrorism list and lifted related sanctions designations tied to the post-Assad government and Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham.
global.whyItMatters: A major geopolitical reset in Syria could affect regional stability, refugee realities, and how churches pray and respond to rebuilding in the Middle East.

global.title: UN condemns killing of peacekeepers in South Sudan ambush
global.summary: The UN has condemned an ambush in Jonglei State, South Sudan, that killed two peacekeepers, underscoring ongoing insecurity in a fragile nation.
global.whyItMatters: South Sudan remains a place where conflict disrupts vulnerable communities; pastors may wish to pray for peace, protection, and faithful witness amid instability.

global.title: South Korea and U.S. agree to coordinate on North Korea
global.summary: Top diplomats from South Korea and the U.S. agreed to work closely on North Korea, signaling renewed alignment on denuclearization and regional security.
global.whyItMatters: Developments on the Korean Peninsula shape global tensions and can guide informed prayer for peace, diplomacy, and the church in East Asia.

canadian.title: Canada to impose retaliatory tariffs on U.S. goods starting Sept. 8
canadian.summary: After trade talks collapsed, Prime Minister Mark Carney announced new Canadian tariffs on a wide range of U.S. goods, including steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp and paper, and electronics.
canadian.whyItMatters: This is the clearest new development for Canadian households and businesses, with likely ripple effects on jobs, prices, and congregational stress.

canadian.title: Canada says it will match U.S. tariffs 'dollar for dollar'
canadian.summary: Canada says it will answer the new U.S. tariffs with reciprocal measures after last-minute changes derailed a hoped-for trade agreement.
canadian.whyItMatters: Pastors may need to help people process uncertainty, economic anxiety, and national tension with wisdom rather than fear.

local.title: Orange air quality warning issued for parts of Fraser Valley
local.summary: An orange air quality warning was issued for Chilliwack, Agassiz, and Hope because of wildfire smoke, with Chilliwack reaching a very high-risk air quality index of 10+.
local.whyItMatters: This has immediate implications for seniors, children, outdoor workers, and medically vulnerable people in the church and community.

local.title: Second fatal drowning in less than two weeks at Cultus Lake
local.summary: RCMP confirmed a man died after drowning near Entrance Bay at Cultus Lake, marking the second fatal drowning there in under two weeks.
local.whyItMatters: A local tragedy like this invites pastoral sensitivity, prayer for grieving families, and practical care around community safety.

local.title: Abbotsford event highlights support for Egyptian student and local cultural connection
local.summary: A Fraser Valley Current feature spotlights the upcoming Egyptian Market in Abbotsford, combining food, music, local vendors, and fundraising for a student from Siwa pursuing university.
local.whyItMatters: This is a meaningful local opportunity to celebrate neighbourliness, generosity, and cross-cultural community engagement.

persecutedChurch.title: 27 Christians killed in Plateau State, Nigeria
persecutedChurch.summary: Fresh attacks in central Nigeria reportedly killed 27 Christians in villages in Plateau State, with local voices describing the violence as targeted and ongoing.
persecutedChurch.whyItMatters: This is a sobering call to pray for protection, justice, and endurance for believers facing deadly hostility.

persecutedChurch.title: Open Doors raises alarm over violence against Christians in Sudan
persecutedChurch.summary: Reports from Sudan describe killings, abductions, and attacks affecting church leaders and Christian communities in the Nuba Mountains amid the wider civil war.
persecutedChurch.whyItMatters: The church in Sudan needs sustained prayer and awareness as conflict deepens suffering and isolates vulnerable believers.

leadership.title: Why leadership begins with attention, not action
leadership.summary: A Forbes piece argues that strong leadership starts with presence, careful attention, and creating conditions where others can grow rather than making the leader the center of everything.
leadership.whyItMatters: Helpful for pastoral leadership: attentive presence, patient discernment, and shared ownership build healthier teams and ministries.

goodNews.title: The Upper Room devotional: 'Allowing God to be God'
goodNews.summary: The latest Upper Room devotional offers a simple invitation to trust God's care and release the pressure to control everything ourselves.
goodNews.whyItMatters: A gentle spiritual reset can serve a pastor well amid heavy news, offering language for rest, trust, and encouragement.
